description: sflow_1d_si_tidal_flat with a patch over the drying slope (x-only refinement) whose right edge the shoreline crosses: wetting and drying (Newton) on the composite system; the coarse faces next to the patch take the coefficients of the fine faces (rsi_couple), so that a coarse shoreline cell is coupled through them. Volume to round-off of the Newton iteration (5e-11 per step).
